newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy BTP-German bund spread reaches 201 Bps.
newsitem.headline: Italy BTP-German bund spread reaches 201 Bps.

text.p: The spread between benchmark Italian BTP bonds and German bunds widened to reach 201 basis points on Monday, the highest level seen since November 1996, dealers said.
Italian bonds fell sharply on Friday on fears of a delay in European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) and were marked down again today in volatile trading.
At 0920 GMT, the benchmark 2006 cash BTP was off 49 basis points at 102.00, while the March LIFFE futures contract was 45 basis points down at 126.80.
